αἴθε: αἴθε — would that, if only; epic particle introducing a wish (= Attic εἴθε)
αὐτή: αὐτός — self; fem. nom. sg., intensive, stressing the subject herself: ’(you) yourself’ · also intensive, 1st person: ’I myself’ (αὐτή μιν πόμπευον ’I myself escorted him’)
γήραος: γῆρας — old age; neut. gen. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic γήρως)
δύσμορον: δύσμορος — ill-fated, unlucky; masc. acc. sg.
δύστηνον: δύστηνος — wretched, unhappy; masc. acc. sg.
εἰσαφικέσθαι: εἰσαφικνέομαι — come to, arrive at; aor. inf. mid. (also in the sense of a command, ’go to’)
εἷλον: αἱρέω — take, seize, catch; aor. 3 pl. act., augmented (εἷλον = ἔ-ελον): ’they caught’ · also aor. 1 sg.: ’I took’ (οἷος Νήρικον εἷλον ’such as I took Nericus’)
εὖνιν: εὖνις — bereft, robbed (of + gen.); adj., masc. acc. sg., agreeing with σε
θάλος: θάλος — young shoot, sapling; of a young person, a ’sprig’; neut. acc. sg.
θαλάμους: θάλαμος — chamber, store-room; masc. acc. pl.: ’chambers’, after εἰς
θύγατρας: θυγάτηρ — daughter; fem. acc. pl., syncopated (= Attic θυγατέρας)
κατέδονται: κατεσθίω (epic κατέδω) — eat up, devour; fut. 3 pl. mid. of ἔδω: ’will devour’
κύν: κύων — dog; masc. acc. sg., elided (κύν’ = κύνα)
οἴκτιστον: οἰκτρός — pitiable, piteous; superl. οἴκτιστος, neut. acc. sg., predicate: ’most pitiable’
πίον: πίνω — drink; aor. 3 pl., epic unaugmented (= ἔπιον): ’they drank’
παρείη: πάρειμι — be at hand, be present; pres. opt. 3 sg. (remote condition): ’were at hand’
πύματόν: πύματος — last, final; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’for the last time’ (acute added on the last syllable by the enclitic τε)
τεκόμεσθα: τίκτω — beget, bear; aor. 1 pl. mid., epic ending -μεσθα, unaugmented (= Attic ἐτεκόμεθα)
τισαίμην: τίνω — pay; mid. τίνυμαι, exact vengeance, punish; aor. opt. mid. 1 sg.: ’I might take vengeance’
τιταινόμενος: τιταίνω — stretch, strain; mid. strain oneself; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.
τοσσόνδε: τοσόσδε (epic τοσσόσδε, with -δε and double σ) — so much, so great; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ὕδωρ: ’so great a stretch of’ · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’so far, so much’ (τοσσόνδε … ἐπιδευέες ’so far lacking’)
φαίνονται: φαίνω — show; mid. appear, show oneself; pres. 3 pl. mid.: ’appear’
ἄνευθ: ἄνευθε(ν) (elided ἄνευθ’) — far off, apart, away; adv.
ἐγεγώνει: γεγωνέω — call aloud, shout; impf. 3 sg.: ’called aloud’
ἐπέοικεν: ἐπέοικα (ἐπί + ἔοικα) — be fitting, be seemly; perf. 3 sg. with pres. sense: ’it is fitting’
ἔδοιεν: ἔδω (= ἐσθίω) — eat; pres. opt. 3 pl., in a fear clause after μή: ’might eat’
